protocol.economics: winner sweeps both stakes; split/dismissed refunds each side its own; unjoined respondents lose by default judgment after the evidence window
protocol.settlement: execute_ruling is permissionless, deterministic and immediate; it survives pause/kill

vercel.database: PostgreSQL (DATABASE_URL env; lazy client, TLS auto for non-local hosts)
vercel.source_note: Fill after the first production deploy; see README → Deploying to Vercel.

notes: This deployment and its client are fixed to the GenLayer Studio network, chain 61999.
Empty strings are intentionally unfilled: copy deployed_at, owner_address and deployment_transaction from the explorer page of the contract when verifying — no value is invented here.
The root deployments.json is the machine-readable registry consumed by the dApp (footer chip, e2e-live.mjs fallback); this file is the human-facing deployment record. Keep both in sync.
Disputes are wei-denominated end to end; dispute ids are 1-based and sequential.
Rulings are single and final: request_resolution can never run twice on the same dispute; dead evidence links degrade to explicit unreachable notes instead of being trusted.
scripts/e2e-live.mjs drives the real contract with two funded Studionet wallets; point EVIDENCE_URL at a page you control so the verdict follows what validators fetch.
